Description: Control Herdr from your Stream Deck: agents, spaces, worktrees, panes.

com.dimer47.herdr.agents-status.Name: Agents — status
com.dimer47.herdr.agents-status.Tooltip: Number of agents per state, refreshed automatically.

com.dimer47.herdr.agent-unblock.Name: Agents — unblock
com.dimer47.herdr.agent-unblock.Tooltip: Sends Escape to the first blocked agent.

com.dimer47.herdr.agent-enter.Name: Agents — confirm
com.dimer47.herdr.agent-enter.Tooltip: Sends Enter to the first blocked agent.

com.dimer47.herdr.agent-continue.Name: Agents — resume
com.dimer47.herdr.agent-continue.Tooltip: Submits "Continue." to the agent in the focused space.

com.dimer47.herdr.agent-stop.Name: Agents — interrupt
com.dimer47.herdr.agent-stop.Tooltip: Sends Ctrl+C to the agent in the focused space.

com.dimer47.herdr.agent-focus.Name: Agents — show blocked
com.dimer47.herdr.agent-focus.Tooltip: Focuses the agent that needs attention.

com.dimer47.herdr.ws-new.Name: Space — new
com.dimer47.herdr.ws-new.Tooltip: Creates a workspace in a chosen folder.

com.dimer47.herdr.wt-new.Name: Worktree — create
com.dimer47.herdr.wt-new.Tooltip: Creates a Git worktree and its workspace.

com.dimer47.herdr.pane-split-right.Name: Pane — split right
com.dimer47.herdr.pane-split-right.Tooltip: Splits the current pane to the right.

com.dimer47.herdr.pane-zoom.Name: Pane — zoom
com.dimer47.herdr.pane-zoom.Tooltip: Toggles zoom on the current pane.

com.dimer47.herdr.server.Name: Server — status
com.dimer47.herdr.server.Tooltip: Herdr server state, version and compatibility.

com.dimer47.herdr.wt-remove.Name: Worktree — remove
com.dimer47.herdr.wt-remove.Tooltip: Removes the worktree of the focused space.

com.dimer47.herdr.pane-focus-left.Name: Pane — focus left
com.dimer47.herdr.pane-focus-left.Tooltip: Moves focus to the pane on the left.

com.dimer47.herdr.pane-focus-right.Name: Pane — focus right
com.dimer47.herdr.pane-focus-right.Tooltip: Moves focus to the pane on the right.

com.dimer47.herdr.pane-focus-up.Name: Pane — focus up
com.dimer47.herdr.pane-focus-up.Tooltip: Moves focus to the pane above.

com.dimer47.herdr.pane-focus-down.Name: Pane — focus down
com.dimer47.herdr.pane-focus-down.Tooltip: Moves focus to the pane below.

com.dimer47.herdr.pane-read.Name: Pane — copy output
com.dimer47.herdr.pane-read.Tooltip: Copies the last 200 lines of the pane to the clipboard.

com.dimer47.herdr.tab-prev.Name: Tab — previous
com.dimer47.herdr.tab-prev.Tooltip: Previous tab of the space, wrapping around.

com.dimer47.herdr.tab-next.Name: Tab — next
com.dimer47.herdr.tab-next.Tooltip: Next tab of the space, wrapping around.

com.dimer47.herdr.command.Name: Custom command
com.dimer47.herdr.command.Tooltip: Runs any Herdr command not covered by a dedicated action.
